segments.source: CTA GTFS; north-turn connector is absent from the GIS segment split

corrections.notes: Reviewed source-ID replacements and explicit estimates; never remove buildings by corridor proximity.

replacements.reason: Merchandise Mart station envelope crosses the rail centerline; replace solid ground extrusion with elevated platforms.
Former Madison/Wabash envelope in older footprint survey; replaced by Washington/Wabash.
Library station envelope including over-track concourse.
Narrow over-track station connector is represented as an elevated walkway, not a solid 23.6 m ground extrusion.
State/Lake north platform envelope; closed reconstruction site.
State/Lake south platform envelope; closed reconstruction site.
Clinton elevated platform and canopy envelope.
Chicago elevated east platform canopy: 146 m long narrow roof envelope alongside the tracks.
Narrow rail-side roof/catwalk envelope south of Tower 18, represented at deck level instead of a solid ground extrusion.

alignmentCorrections.reason: The generalized GIS/GTFS centerline grazes measured roof footprints along the alley. This explicit lateral profile holds both tracks inside the available right-of-way. Center deviation is approximately 6 m at its maximum; this is a documented manual review exception; original geographic shapes remain unchanged. Roosevelt platform is centered south of the station reference point to accommodate its island and eight-car consists.

transfers.kind: walk through Block 37 / Pedway; fare rules apply

closures.message: State/Lake elevated closed for reconstruction into 2029; trains pass without stopping.
Rail service restored October 29, 2026; lower roadway remains closed.

accuracy.trackCenterlines: CTA GIS, checked against dated GTFS; tracks generally offset 1.8 m from shared corridor centers, widening around the Roosevelt island platform.
accuracy.elevation: Estimated local rail profiles: 8.9 m typical, rising over double-deck river bridges. Not surveyed.
accuracy.platforms: Location and direction from CTA; dimensions and architecture are representative exterior models.
accuracy.entrances: CC0 historical entrance points; not a current accessibility or entrance-availability guide.
accuracy.trains: Representative consists: Brown/Orange 8, Green/Purple 6, Pink 4 cars. Illustrative assignment, not live fleet data.
